name: Posting time reminders — noon + evening PM2 crons
goal: Add scripts/posting-reminder.ts (lightweight Telegram nudge at posting times) + two PM2 cron entries in ecosystem.config.js: kognai-post-noon (0 12 * * *) and kognai-post-evening (0 18 * * *). Script: checks gate status (posts done/needed/days left), finds #1 unposted video with captioned mp4 on disk (same run_id→epoch logic as /post-now), sends compact Telegram message to owner with video_id, file path, hashtags, /record command. Skips send if gate already met (30 posts done).
rationale: 0/30 posts, 22 days to Apr 7. Daily digest warns at 7am but operator has no automated nudge at the two highest-conversion posting slots (12:00, 18:00). PM2 crons that push a 'post this now' Telegram message will significantly increase posting frequency.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 new script + 1 ecosystem.config.js edit. Direct write.
